decision.explanation: Document D1 explicitly states Grigore Arbore received the 'Order of Faithful Service' (D1S9, D1S12). Document D2, presented as a news report, claims he won the 'Top Artist' award at the 2023 Billboard Music Awards (D2S2). While D2 contains factual impossibilities regarding the historical figure (who died in 1893), the prompt instructions require preserving distinct valid referents and complementary answers found in the source text without rejecting them based on external knowledge or treating the text as false solely due to contradiction. Both 'Order of Faithful Service' and 'Top Artist' are explicitly cited as awards received by the subject in the provided documents. Other candidates (e.g., Grand Cross, specific citations) are either classes of the order, incidental details, or not explicitly named as the award received.
